title: elegance: split stoa_auth::CredentialStore import in server_stores.rs
description: server_stores.rs line 22 already has 'use stoa_auth::{OidcStore, TrustedIssuerStore}'. The new 'use stoa_auth::CredentialStore' on line 31 is a standalone duplicate stoa_auth import that could be merged into the existing group: 'use stoa_auth::{CredentialStore, OidcStore, TrustedIssuerStore}'. The split form is not wrong but breaks the implicit convention that imports from the same external crate are grouped.
